As you know from my previous posts, me and DAK1124 did some recruiting after the last time the FBI cracked down on us. I know what you might be thinking, but we were super careful recruiting this time and we need more members. Changes do not happen themselves, you know? Oh, right. If I see you, TommiiJ, spamming ‘GLOWIES GLOWIES’ again, I will ban your ass. For real this time. Every one of you joined my organisation at some point so please don’t even try degrading new guys only because you ware around longer. I want this place to be welcoming for everyone.
	It’s not my first rodeo, so please have some confidence in me. Feds are not stupid so breaches sometimes happen. I’m doing all I can to protect you my fellow friends. That’s why some of the new guys had to do some jobs for me, to prove their loyalty. Since all of them were successful, I know there were no feds or snitches among them. DAK also did some checking on his own.
	With that out of the way. Welcome new members! It’s good to know that there are still people who care in this country, it really is. You must be wondering, what is this all about, right? So far I’ve been very cryptic, but on this protected blog I can tell you everything. In the recent decade our lives changed a lot, not in a good way. Everyday more regulations are being forced onto us by the government. Some people complained about the gun ban, but I’m not into guns, so I didn’t care (guns are bad!). Then people complained about the combustion car ban and how electric ones' prices rose by 700% (we have only one Earth and we need to treat her well). I didn’t care, because my workplace was close and commuting by bike was good enough for me. What opened my eyes and likely many of you reading this feel the same, was the sexbot ban and AI regulations… Protests were futile and brutally pacified. Since then I knew that I no longer lived in a free country… 
	Soon, every new member will be put in a squad. Every squad has a squad leader. Squad leaders are my trusted associates with whom I’ve worked for many years, I trust them completely. Regular members have to obey them completely. Do not send me any complaints about them, please. 
	Now we will make sure our voices are heard… I can’t tell you much about the details, but we plan to replace the US government and put a powerful AI based on the personality of Thomas Jefferson in its place. It’s still a work in progress. For example recent problem: we had to mix in a little bit of Obama, because Jefferson was born in the XVIII century and some of his opinions are outdated. We wouldn’t want slavery to be legal again, now would we? 
	That’s it for now, remember to like my post and comment, it helps me stay motivated and further our agenda. Stay respectful in the comment section and feel free to give me feedback! 

PS Let’s thank DAK1124 for his great work with the recruiting emails. I don’t know what he did, but he recruited far more than me and now we have a ton of new members.
